system.description:
Play the Field Archaeologist if you want to put yourself at risk to uncover forgotten knowledge.

Features

Quick-Thinking. When a trap or environmental hazard is triggered, you may mark a Stress to act immediately against it. You may mark 2 Stress instead to roll with Advantage.

Unorthodox Solution. Once per scene, you may employ outside-the-box solutions to roll a d20 as your Hope die. If you fail, you must also mark a Stress.
